projects.title: AI-OS
projects.subtitle: Your files. Your machine. Your AI.
projects.problem: Finding a file should not mean remembering what you named it.
projects.built: An offline Windows assistant that searches, summarizes and organizes files using a local language model and semantic search.
projects.result: Local inference. Review-before-apply file actions. Recoverable deletion.
projects.detail: Phi-3 Mini handles language tasks while sentence-transformers and ChromaDB make documents searchable by meaning. The interface separates the proposed action from its execution, and duplicate removal uses the recycle bin.
projects.limit: Requires a Windows machine and local model installation. Performance depends on available hardware.

projects.title: ORBIT Gesture Studio
projects.subtitle: A webcam. A gesture. Your desktop.
projects.problem: Turn a hand gesture into a useful desktop action, with control over when it runs.
projects.built: A gesture studio with live recognition, configurable mappings and a disarmed-by-default action system.
projects.result: Explicit action allowlist. Emergency stop. Local camera processing.
projects.detail: Static hand poses map to approved desktop actions. The studio lets you tune thresholds and test mappings before arming the system. Camera frames stay in memory.
projects.limit: Motion gestures are experimental. The repository demo uses simulated landmarks, and synthetic tests do not establish real-world recognition accuracy.

projects.title: RaceLine-AI
projects.subtitle: Learning the racing line.
projects.problem: Can an agent learn to drive a circuit from feedback instead of a scripted racing line?
projects.built: A custom racing environment, PPO training pipeline and browser dashboard for inspecting laps, crashes and replay data.
projects.result: From simulation to training to a shareable, data-driven dashboard.
projects.detail: The environment models drag, grip and rolling resistance. Observations describe speed, alignment and track position; rewards combine forward progress, crashes and completed laps.
projects.limit: A simulated learning environment, not a real vehicle controller. No lap-time improvement claim is made without a sourced training run.

projects.title: VeilRelay
projects.subtitle: A privacy layer for AI prompts.
projects.problem: Sensitive text can leave your application inside an otherwise ordinary AI prompt.
projects.built: A self-hosted OpenAI-compatible proxy that replaces detected sensitive values with reversible typed placeholders.
projects.result: Request-scoped mapping, streamed response support and value-free audit logs.
projects.detail: Pattern detectors and validators inspect supported text before forwarding it. Known placeholders are restored in normal and streamed responses. The project includes a threat model and reproducible benchmark artifacts.
projects.limit: Alpha software. Detection is incomplete and does not guarantee privacy or compliance. Current benchmark results are a small synthetic smoke test, not production accuracy.

projects.title: Static Fire Ground Station
projects.subtitle: From serial data to a clear decision.
projects.problem: Static-fire testing needs readable telemetry and explicit operator controls.
projects.built: A PyQt6 ground station with serial input, live plots, interlocked states, simulation mode and CSV logging.
projects.result: A browser simulation lets you explore the interface without hardware.
projects.detail: The desktop app starts in simulation mode. Its state machine separates safe, armed, burn and complete states, while session data is written to CSV. A browser demo makes the workflow inspectable.
projects.limit: The browser experience is a simulation. It is not an independently certified safety system.
